typography.rules: Avoid generic sans (Inter). Do not center-align by default. Line height tight for headers, loose for body.

colors.rules: Never use pure black or pure gray; tint grays warmly. Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Primary color used sparingly for key CTAs.

layout.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) for containers. Optical alignment over mathematical.
layout.rules: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children for even heights. Grid items must be direct children. Limit image heights to 80vh on mobile.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces. 1px subtle border (border-border). No default shadow.
cards.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), soft shadow (shadow-sm), border darkens slightly.

ai_insights_panel.style: Neumorphic or gently tinted (bg-brand-accent/10) to distinguish from purely financial data.

navigation.style: Visible nav bar on desktop. Glassmorphism only if sticky (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-white/40). Otherwise solid.
navigation.links: Hover state must explicitly set text color.

forms.style: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Avoid native inputs. Dense and compact for data entry.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions for feedback. Explicit hover colors.
motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations.

icons.rules: Solid/outline based on visual weight. Don't over-saturate UI with icons.

avatar.description: Professional avatar portrait for user profile

media.rules: No placeholder URLs. Max 80vh on mobile.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 'Control Room' grid dashboard layout for financial management.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, and Shadcn UI (customized) for interactive elements.
Implement Shadcn charts or Recharts for financial data (revenue, expenses, cash flow).
Include a dedicated AI Insights panel to surface tasks, anomalies, and suggestions. Style this panel distinctly.
Ensure the layout accommodates file uploads (Excel/CSV) and a connection UI for Google Drive.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard fonts for headings. Follow the typography rules rigidly.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, forms, links) and important data points.
Implement a light theme based on the Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) color palette provided.
